PowerShell("Listeners on 8000:"; Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { $p = Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; "  PID $\($_.OwningProcess\) [$\($p.ProcessName\)] local=$\($_.LocalAddress\)" }; ""; "Health check \(15s\):"; try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:8000/health" -TimeoutSec 15; $r | ConvertTo-Json -Compress } catch { "ERROR: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })
